title: Autellix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs
authors: Michael Luo; Xiaoxiang Shi; Colin Cai; Tianjun Zhang; Justin Wong; Yichuan Wang; Chi Wang; Yanping Huang; Zhifeng Chen; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
venue_full: Published as Agentix at the 23rd USENIX Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation (NSDI 2026)
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems treat LLM calls as independent requests, ignoring program-level dependencies and context, which leads to head-of-line blocking and suboptimal end-to-end latency for agentic programs. This results in significant waiting times for programs as they scale their inference computation.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統將每次 LLM 呼叫視為獨立請求，忽略程式層級的依賴關係與上下文，導致 agentic 程式出現隊頭阻塞（head-of-line blocking）與次優的端到端延遲；隨著 inference 計算規模擴大，程式等待時間也隨之顯著增加。

key_innovation.en: Autellix introduces a stateful serving engine that treats agentic programs as first-class citizens, utilizing program-level statistics (cumulative service time) to inform scheduling and load balancing. It proposes two non-clairvoyant scheduling algorithms, PLAS (for single-threaded) and ATLAS (for multi-threaded DAGs), to prioritize calls based on program progress.
key_innovation.zh: Autellix 引入一套有狀態的 serving 引擎，將 agentic 程式作為一等公民，利用程式層級統計資訊（累計服務時間）指導 scheduling 與負載均衡。其提出兩種非預知型 scheduling 演算法：PLAS（針對單執行緒）與 ATLAS（針對多執行緒 DAG），依據程式進度對呼叫進行優先排序。

key_improvements.en: 4-15x throughput increase at the same latency compared to vLLM; up to 1.5x throughput improvement over standard load-balancers across engines.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同延遲條件下，吞吐量相較於 vLLM 提升 4–15x；跨引擎場景中相較於標準負載均衡器吞吐量最高提升 1.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Agentic Programs, Multi-agent Systems, ReAct, MCTS, Chatbot

workloads_traces.en: ShareGPT conversations, BFCL v3 function calling, LATS/HotpotQA MCTS programs, and an equal-sampled mixed workload; both single-thread PLAS and dynamic multithread ATLAS programs.
workloads_traces.zh: ShareGPT conversations、BFCL v3 function calling、LATS/HotpotQA MCTS programs，以及等比例 mixed workload；涵蓋 single-thread PLAS 與 dynamic multithread ATLAS programs。

key_parameters.en: vLLM 0.6.1; 8x A100 80 GB host with 1,360 GB RAM; 8B/70B/180B use 1/4/8 GPUs; ShareGPT mean/max 6.66/80 calls and 256/277 prefill/decode tokens; BFCL 10.75/70 calls and 735.06/34.14 tokens; LATS 159.7 calls and 467.2/72.6 tokens; Poisson program arrivals; requests below 2,048 tokens route to least-used engine, longer requests stay pinned; offline up to 4,000 programs. Numeric arrival rates, scheduler K/beta/N/quanta, max batch, cache capacity, and tool delays not stated.
key_parameters.zh: vLLM 0.6.1；8x A100 80 GB 主機配備 1,360 GB RAM；8B/70B/180B 分別使用 1/4/8 GPUs；ShareGPT 平均/最大 6.66/80 calls、prefill/decode 256/277 tokens；BFCL 為 10.75/70 calls、735.06/34.14 tokens；LATS 為 159.7 calls、467.2/72.6 tokens；Poisson program arrivals；低於 2,048 tokens 的 request 路由至 least-used engine，較長 request 固定於 program engine；offline 評測最多 4,000 programs。數值 arrival rates、scheduler K/beta/N/quanta、max batch、cache 容量與工具延遲未載明。

metrics_defined.en: Program token latency is response time divided by generated tokens; for multithreaded programs it is critical-path response time divided by total tokens across threads; P95/P99 use the same normalization.
metrics_defined.zh: Program token latency 定義為 response time 除以 generated tokens；multithreaded program 則為 critical-path response time 除以各 thread 的總 tokens；P95/P99 使用相同正規化。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Up to 15x throughput on the mixed workload versus vLLM; multi-engine gains are up to 1.4x over Round Robin/Least Used, and equal-tail-throughput gains are up to 1.7x.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: mixed workload 相較 vLLM 的 throughput 最高為 15x；multi-engine 相較 Round Robin/Least Used 最高為 1.4x，在相同 tail latency 下 throughput 最高為 1.7x。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: Autellix does not require a future graph, but assumes program IDs and runtime call/thread history correctly expose related work; topology changes weaken fairness and locality only when that lineage is lost.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: Autellix 不要求未來 graph，但假設 program ID 與執行期 call/thread history 能正確標示相關工作；只有在該 lineage 遺失時，拓撲變動才會削弱公平性與 locality。
